basicFields.descriptionPlaceholder: Details or rules for this task...
basicFields.importanceTooltipAria: Learn how to choose Habit Importance and its rewards
basicFields.importanceTooltipAriaProductivity: Learn how to choose Habit Importance
basicFields.importanceTooltipIntro: Defines the weight of this habit in your progression and the reward per check-in:
basicFields.importanceTooltipIntroProductivity: Defines the impact and priority of this habit in your daily routine:
basicFields.importanceRuleBody: If it takes under 2 minutes, use <bold>Low</bold>. If it's part of your standard routine, use <bold>Normal</bold>. Save <bold>High</bold> for the 1 or 2 most challenging habits of your day.

importanceDescriptions.LOW: Quick or complementary micro-habits (e.g., drink water, stretch 2 min).
importanceDescriptions.NORMAL: Consistent everyday habits (e.g., read 10 pages, meditate, study 20 min).
importanceDescriptions.HIGH: Core pillars requiring high discipline (e.g., intense workout, avoiding a hard vice).

basicFields.difficultyTooltipAria: Learn how to choose Difficulty and view rewards
basicFields.effortTooltipAria: Learn how to estimate Task Effort
basicFields.difficultyTooltipIntro: Classify by the real effort and estimated time to complete the activity:
basicFields.effortTooltipIntro: Classify by the real effort and estimated time to complete the activity:

difficultyDescriptions.TRIVIAL: Quick, effortless actions (< 5 min, e.g., take vitamins, make the bed).
difficultyDescriptions.EASY: Simple everyday tasks (5–20 min, e.g., review schedule, do the dishes).
difficultyDescriptions.MEDIUM: Requires moderate focus and dedication (30–60 min, e.g., study session, workout).
difficultyDescriptions.HARD: High effort, complexity, or long duration (+1h, e.g., deliver project, exam).

habitFields.directionTooltipIntro: Defines whether this habit is something you want to build, avoid, or balance:
habitFields.positiveBulletDesc: Good habit to build (e.g., drink water, study). Each <bold>+</bold> grants XP and Coins.
habitFields.negativeBulletDesc: Bad habit or vice to avoid (e.g., nail biting, fast food). Clicking <bold>-</bold> applies a 50% penalty to build awareness.
habitFields.bothBulletDesc: Balanced behavior (e.g., healthy meal vs. cheat meal). Enables both buttons on the card.
habitFields.resetTooltipIntro: Defines how often the repetition counters (+/- score) reset to zero:
habitFields.resetDailyDesc: Resets every day at midnight (e.g., drink water, daily workout).
habitFields.resetWeeklyDesc: Resets every Monday (e.g., go to the gym 3x a week).
habitFields.resetMonthlyDesc: Resets on the 1st of each month (e.g., read 2 books a month).
habitFields.resetStreakNote: 🛡️ Your Streak and accumulated coins are <bold>NOT</bold> lost when the counter resets!

dailyFields.monthlyTooltipAria: Learn about the monthly repeat options for the task
dailyFields.monthlyTooltipIntro: Defines how the task's next date will be calculated each month after completion:
dailyFields.monthlyDayOfMonthDesc: Always repeats on the same numeric date (e.g., every 15th). Ideal for bills, monthly reports, and fixed goals.
dailyFields.monthlyDayOfWeekDesc: Keeps the relative weekday position (e.g., every 2nd Tuesday of the month). Ideal for recurring meetings, appointments, or calendar rituals.
dailyFields.monthlyNote: 💡 Both options respect the interval set in "Every (months)".

todoFields.dueDateFrozenHint: 🔒 Date frozen: deadline expired in Hardcore Mode.
todoFields.singleDueTimeHint: A single time acts as a deadline. For an event with duration, also set the End Time.
todoFields.eventTimeRangeHint: Event from {start} to {end} — stays "In progress" during that window and only becomes overdue after {end}.
todoFields.inAppReminderAlertInfo: You will receive an alert in your in-app notifications ({when}). If you also want an email reminder, toggle the option below.
todoFields.emailReminderQuotaBadge: Free: up to 5 active (20/mo) • VIP: up to 30 active (100/mo)
todoFields.emailUnverifiedDesc: Verify your account email to enable email alerts.
todoFields.emailVerifiedDesc: We'll send an email alert when the reminder time arrives.

hardcore.title: Hardcore Mode (Anti-Procrastination)
hardcore.tooltipAria: Learn how Hardcore Mode helps overcome procrastination
hardcore.todoIntro: Acts as a <bold>behavioral lock</bold> for deliverables you tend to put off and cannot fail:
hardcore.todoNoSelfSabotageDesc: Requires a due date and blocks postponing once overdue.
hardcore.todoCriticalAlertDesc: Adds priority highlight on the card and alerts so it won't be missed.
hardcore.todoPenaltyDesc: If not completed by 23:59 on the due date, deducts 50% of the task's value from your balance.
hardcore.todoLateDeliveryDesc: Completing late pays only half the reward.
hardcore.todoWhenToActivateDesc: Use only on those 1 or 2 crucial deliverables of the week where you need real accountability to act on time.
hardcore.routineIntro: Acts as a <bold>discipline pact</bold> for your most important goal of the day:
hardcore.routinePriorityFocusDesc: Signals on the board that this routine is non-negotiable today.
hardcore.routinePenaltyDesc: If not completed by 23:59, deducts 50% of the routine's value from your balance.
hardcore.routineZeroStreakDesc: Your Streak resets to Day 1 if you fail.
hardcore.routineWhenToActivateDesc: Save for the #1 habit or routine you are determined not to skip no matter what.
hardcore.todoSubtitle: Locks due date against postponing and charges a penalty if late
hardcore.todoSubtitleProductivity: Locks due date against postponing and applies a penalty if late
hardcore.routineSubtitle: For non-negotiable goals: charges a penalty if missed today
hardcore.routineSubtitleProductivity: For non-negotiable goals: applies a penalty if missed today
hardcore.todoActiveAlert: High Risk Active: 50% penalty if not completed by the due date. Date cannot be postponed once overdue.
hardcore.routineActiveAlert: High Risk Active: 50% penalty in Coins and XP if not completed today.
